_about: Sample claimed businesses for the design preview. Fictional: names, addresses and offers are made up; phone numbers use Ofcom's reserved drama range (020 7946 0xxx). In WordPress this data comes from claimed listings, offers and events. tier: basic | enhanced | premium | partner. Days: Mon..Sun.

businesses.name: Hill Street Kitchen
businesses.tagline: Seasonal British cooking on Harrow on the Hill
description: A neighbourhood restaurant at the top of the Hill, cooking seasonal British food with produce from farms around London. The menu changes every few weeks; Sunday roasts are the main event.
There is a heated garden terrace for warmer evenings, a private room for up to 20, and a children's menu all week. We host a live jazz supper club once a month.

offers.title: 2-for-1 mains, Monday to Thursday
offers.text: Order any two mains and the cheaper one is free. Dine in only. Show this offer when you order.

offers.title: Kids eat free on Sundays
offers.text: One free children’s meal with every adult Sunday roast. Under 12s.

businesses.name: Wealdstone Fitness Studio
businesses.tagline: Small-group strength, spin and yoga in Wealdstone
description: An independent studio for people who don't like big gyms. Classes are capped at 12, so coaches know your name and your goals.
We run strength, spin, yoga and weekend bootcamps, plus beginner courses every month. Showers, lockers and free towels included.
New members start with a free one-to-one session to set goals, and every class has an option for beginners.

offers.title: A free week of classes
offers.text: Seven days of unlimited classes for new members. Book online with the code below.

offers.title: No joining fee in November
offers.text: Save £30 when you join on any monthly membership this month.

businesses.name: Hatch End Bookshop & Café
businesses.tagline: New and second-hand books, good coffee and Saturday story time
description: A small independent bookshop with a café at the back. We stock new fiction, local history and a big children's section, plus a rotating shelf of second-hand finds.
Coffee is roasted in North London, cakes are baked locally, and story time for under-6s runs every Saturday morning.
We order any book in print within two days, host monthly author evenings and run a reading group on the first Thursday of the month.

offers.title: Free coffee with any slice of cake
offers.text: Weekdays before 11am. One per customer per visit.

offers.title: 10% off every book, all winter
offers.text: New and second-hand books, in store only. Not valid on gift cards or events.

businesses.name: Stanmore Family Dental
businesses.tagline: NHS and private dentistry for the whole family
description: A family-run practice on Stanmore Broadway offering NHS and private dentistry, hygienist appointments, Invisalign and same-day emergency care.
New patients are welcome, and we see children from their first tooth. The practice has step-free access and a ground-floor surgery.
Our dentists explain every option and cost before treatment starts, and nervous patients can ask for longer appointments.

offers.title: £25 off your first hygienist visit
offers.text: For new private patients. Mention Harrow Online when you book by phone or online.

offers.title: Free electric toothbrush with a new patient exam
offers.text: For adults joining as private patients. While stocks last.

businesses.name: Station Road Barbers
description: Traditional and modern cuts, skin fades, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Walk in or book online.
Three chairs, open seven days, and student prices every Tuesday.

Our barbers have more than 30 years of experience between them. Children's cuts are welcome every day, and we keep a quiet chair for anyone who prefers a calmer visit. Card and contactless payments are accepted.

offers.title: 20% off your first cut
offers.text: Any cut or cut and beard trim, Monday to Friday. Show the code at the till.

offers.title: Student Tuesdays: £15 cuts
offers.text: Every Tuesday with a valid student card. Walk-ins welcome.

businesses.name: Pinner Village Florist
description: Fresh, seasonal flowers arranged in the shop every morning. Bouquets, wedding flowers, sympathy tributes and plants, with same-day local delivery when you order by 1pm.
We also run seasonal wreath-making workshops and look after flowers for local cafés, offices and events. Call in to choose stems yourself or ask us to design something special.

businesses.name: Bright Sparks Coding
businesses.tagline: Saturday coding clubs for 8 to 12 year olds
description: Hands-on coding clubs where children build games, animations and simple websites. Small groups of up to 10, with DBS-checked tutors.
Terms run alongside Harrow school terms. Laptops are provided; children just bring themselves.
Every child leaves each term with a finished project to show family and friends. Parents get a short progress note after each half term, and siblings get a discount.

offers.title: First session free
offers.text: Try a Saturday club before you book the term. One free session per child.

businesses.name: Harrow Town Centre Traders
businesses.tagline: The voice of Harrow town centre's independent businesses
description: A volunteer-run association of shops, cafés and services in Harrow town centre. We run seasonal markets and late-night shopping, and speak up for local traders.

businesses.name: Rayners Lane Spice House
businesses.tagline: North Indian cooking and takeaway in Rayners Lane
description: Family recipes from Punjab and Lucknow, cooked to order. Tandoor grills, slow-cooked dals and a long vegetarian menu.
Dine in, collect or order delivery across Rayners Lane, Pinner and South Harrow. Private dining for parties of up to 40.
Ask about our weekday lunch thali and the monthly curry and quiz night, both popular with regulars.

offers.title: Free poppadoms and chutneys with any takeaway over £20
offers.text: Collection or delivery. Mention Harrow Online when you order.

businesses.name: Pinner Cycle Workshop
businesses.tagline: Bike repairs, servicing and second-hand bikes
description: Repairs and servicing for every kind of bike, from children's first bikes to e-bikes. Most repairs done the same day.
We also sell refurbished second-hand bikes and run beginners' maintenance classes.
Drop your bike off before work and collect it on the way home. We give a written quote before any work starts, and all repairs come with a 30-day guarantee.

offers.title: Free winter bike safety check
offers.text: Brakes, lights and tyres checked while you wait. No booking needed.

businesses.name: Kenton Road Pharmacy
businesses.tagline: Independent pharmacy with free health checks
description: Prescriptions, repeat prescription collection and delivery, travel vaccines and NHS Pharmacy First consultations.
Our pharmacists offer free blood pressure checks and winter flu jabs, with no appointment needed.
We stock a wide range of medicines, baby care and skin care, and our team speaks English, Gujarati, Hindi and Tamil. Free local delivery is available for housebound patients.

offers.title: Free blood pressure check
offers.text: Walk in any weekday. Takes five minutes and you get a printed result.

businesses.name: Edgware Heating & Plumbing
businesses.tagline: Gas Safe boiler servicing, repairs and plumbing
description: Gas Safe registered engineers covering Edgware, Stanmore and Canons Park. Boiler servicing and repairs, new boilers, radiators and general plumbing.
Fixed prices for servicing, and same-day call-outs for emergencies when we can.
Every job comes with a written quote, and our engineers clean up before they leave. We fit new boilers with manufacturer warranties of up to ten years.

offers.title: £20 off a boiler service
offers.text: For homes in Harrow and Edgware. Book by phone and quote the code.
